The goal is to ensure seamless updates and deployments with minimal downtime, thereby enhancing user experience and operational efficiency. The process will involve setting up two identical environments: one active (blue) and one idle (green). During deployment, the new version of the application will be deployed to the green environment while the blue environment continues to serve traffic. Once the new version is verified, traffic will be switched to the green environment, allowing for quick rollbacks if necessary. This approach not only reduces downtime but also mitigates risks associated with new deployments. The project will include thorough testing and validation to ensure that the deployment process is smooth and reliable, ultimately leading to improved application performance and user satisfaction.
